snippet.title: Oops! You're the Hero! - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Artificium Games is a studio founded by indie developer Kit following her time spent attending Girls Make Games. With eight years of game design experience, Kit has now announced her first commercial title, an adventure game titled Oops! You're the Hero!

Steam Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3166160/Oops_Youre_the_Hero/

Learn more:
https://www.nettosgameroom.com/2026/07/kit-of-artificium-games-discusses-girls.html
